text:
On a warm day, a carton of fresh milk is covered with a wet cloth.
Why does this help to reduce the temperature of the milk?
A
Some water evaporates from the cloth so the remaining water becomes cooler.
B
The water has a very high thermal capacity.
C
The water insulates the milk from the warm air around it.
D
Water is always colder than the air around it.

options.label: A
options.text: Some water evaporates from the cloth so the remaining water becomes cooler.

options.label: B
options.text: The water has a very high thermal capacity.

options.label: C
options.text: The water insulates the milk from the warm air around it.

options.label: D
options.text: Water is always colder than the air around it.
